thread:
rachel: Quick follow-up on yesterday's RFC — proposal: decouple admission tokens from lease objects so operator handoff and retries are simpler. PTAL, especially around revocation and metrics. cc @sam @taylor

sam: +1 to separation. Tokens are ephemeral auth/assertion, leases are scheduling contracts. Keeping them separate makes retries and prewarm easier.

taylor: Agree. Main tradeoff is visibility: operator needs timely token state to avoid double-admit. We should define a small revocation stream.

leo: Can we keep token as a tiny object: {id, pool, tenant, holder_id, expires_at, generation}? then operator reconciler reads token index only.

irene: Concern: backward compatibility for existing operator; we need a migration path where both tokens and leases are accepted during rollout.

rachel: Migration plan idea: 1) control-plane writes tokens and mirrors to lease for old operators, 2) feature-flag rollout to stop mirroring, 3) full cutover. Rollback is mirror-on again.

sam: For revocation, I'd prefer a push channel (event stream) instead of polling index. We already have zk/pubsub; tie token events to that. Operator subscribes to token.revocations and token.updates.

leo: +1. Also emit prometheus counters: token_created, token_revoked, token_in_flight_per_pool. That helps billing and debugging prewarm thrash.

irene: Also add a safe-ttl window: when token revoked, operator waits safe_ttl before force-evict to let in-flight requests finish. Configurable per-tenant.

rachel: Draft token schema (quick):
```
{
  "id": "tok_...",
  "pool": "dedicated-a",
  "tenant": "team-x",
  "holder_id": "node-17",
  "expires_at": 1715000000,
  "generation": 3,
  "flags": ["prewarm","burst"]
}
```

sam: Looks good. generation helps detect stale holders. Use monotonic increment on reassign.

taylor: Operator surface: need APIs: GetTokens(pool), WatchTokens(stream), RevokeToken(id, reason). Keep responses tiny.

devops-bot: deploy-preview: control-plane/token-service v0.9 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20T14:12Z (sha: ab12cd).

rachel: Next steps: (1) write short RFC addendum for token lifecycle & migration, (2) implement WatchTokens API + metrics, (3) stage rollout with mirror-on flag. Who wants to own the addendum?

sam: I'll draft the addendum and include example operator pseudocode for watch loop.

leo: I can own WatchTokens impl and metrics.

irene: I'll write the migration checklist and rollback playbook.

rachel: Awesome. Let's sync Tues 10am if needed. Thanks all :rocket:
